versions.content: The Dem module shall report DTCs in the chronological order of the event storage (refer to API Dem_GetNextFilteredDTC ), if: • the DTCStatus parameter has the“pending DTC” or “confirmed DTC” bit or both bits set • all other bits of the DTCStatus parameter are set to false • DemResetConfirmedBitOnOverflow is set to true
